name: admin draft pricing: bob sets global price, carol pays it
description: Proves paid-draft pricing is a GLOBAL admin dial, not a hardcoded 25%. bob (creator admin) sets firstCost=1000 stepPct=50, funds carol, then carol buys and is billed the new ladder. Restores shipped defaults at the end.

steps._comment: HARD ASSERT: DBG is admin-only.

steps.name: run admin command
steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); if (!el) return 'ERR no input'; const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; if (el.value !== 'admin') { set.call(el, 'admin'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.focus(); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13, bubbles: true })); return 'submitted'; })()

steps._comment: HARD ASSERT: pricing panel loaded (not the loading branch, which has no inputs).

steps.name: type firstCost=1000 stepPct=50 roundTo=25
steps.expression: (() => { const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; const put = (f, v) => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=dp-input-' + f + ']'); if (!el) return 'ERR ' + f; set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return f + '=' + v; }; return [put('firstCost','1000'), put('stepPct','50'), put('roundTo','25')].join(' '); })()

steps._comment: HARD ASSERT: panel recognises unsaved edits and labels the table PREVIEW.
HARD ASSERT: tier #3 of the 1000/+50% ladder. Computed by the SHARED tiersFor(), so this proves the preview uses the same maths the server charges with.

steps.name: scroll [data-testid=dp-save] into view
steps.expression: (() => { const e = document.querySelector("[data-testid=dp-save]"); if (!e) return 'MISSING '+'[data-testid=dp-save]'; e.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return 'scrolled'; })()
steps._comment: The admin panel body scrolls (maxHeight 85vh). The runner clicks by element coordinates but does NOT scroll first, so a control below the fold gets a click at an off-screen y and silently does nothing - the step still reports OK. Scroll first, then click, so hit-testing stays honest.
HARD ASSERT: server accepted the write.
HARD ASSERT: saved value round-tripped, table is LIVE NOW again.
HARD ASSERT: firstCost is now an explicit override, not the default.
Chip click loads the user. NOTE: admin.getUser wants the u/-prefixed name, and the chip supplies it — do not type a bare name here.
HARD ASSERT: carol has a user record loaded. Set Credits computes a DELTA from the loaded record, so it is wrong to click it before this appears.

steps.name: carol BEFORE
steps.expression: (() => { const o = {}; document.querySelectorAll('table tr').forEach(tr => { const td = tr.querySelectorAll('td'); if (td.length === 2) o[td[0].innerText.trim()] = td[1].innerText.trim(); }); return JSON.stringify({ credits: o.Credits, paidPicks: o['Paid Picks'], freeDrafts: o['Free Drafts'] }); })()

steps.name: set credits field to 50000
steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=admin-credits-input]'); if (!el) return 'ERR no credits input'; const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(el, '50000'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'typed'; })()

steps.name: scroll [data-testid=admin-set-credits] into view
steps.expression: (() => { const e = document.querySelector("[data-testid=admin-set-credits]"); if (!e) return 'MISSING '+'[data-testid=admin-set-credits]'; e.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return 'scrolled'; })()

The runner clicks by element coordinates but does NOT scroll first, so a control below the fold gets a click at an off-screen y and silently does nothing - the step still reports OK. Scroll first, then click, so hit-testing stays honest.
HARD ASSERT: adjustCredits succeeded.
Coach bubble swallows nav taps. This is normal FTUE chrome, not a bug.
let draft.nextCost land - until it does the button says just BUY A DRAFT with no price
THE CORE ASSERT: a DIFFERENT user's client shows the step bob just set. Proves the dial is global and the copy is server-derived, not the hardcoded +25%.

steps.name: carol hub BEFORE buy
steps.expression: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('.dh-btn.credit'); const cost = parseInt((btn?.innerText || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10); const stat = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dh-stat')].find(s => /CREDITS/.test(s.querySelector('.dh-stat-lbl')?.innerText || '')); const credits = parseInt((stat?.querySelector('.dh-stat-val')?.innerText || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10); window.__c = { cost, credits, disabled: !!btn?.disabled, note: document.querySelector('.dh-credit-note')?.innerText.trim() }; return JSON.stringify(window.__c); })()

steps.name: expected NEXT tier price
steps.expression: (() => { const ladder = Array.from({length: 10}, (_, i) => Math.round(1000 * Math.pow(1.5, i) / 25) * 25); const n = ladder.indexOf(window.__c.cost); return n < 0 ? 'OFF-LADDER-' + window.__c.cost : ladder[n + 1].toLocaleString(); })()
steps._comment: Index into the 1000/+50%/25 ladder and take the NEXT tier. Rounding is applied to the exact compounded value per tier and never carried forward, so multiplying the already-rounded price would drift at tier 5+.
HARD ASSERT: carol was billed EXACTLY the displayed price - no more, no less.
HARD ASSERT: the ladder advanced one tier under the NEW config, so the escalation itself is driven by the admin dial.
